categories.name: Messaging & Quoting
categories.description: Text, replies, quoted messages, mentions, edits, deletes, reactions, and read receipts.

categories.name: Media & Attachments
categories.description: Images, videos, audio/voice notes, documents, albums, media download streams, and uploads.

categories.name: Stickers & Packs
categories.description: Single WebP stickers, sticker packs (plogme stickerPackMessage ≤ 60), and animated transcode.

categories.name: Polls & Interactive Voting
categories.description: Poll creation, single/multi-choice, vote updates, vote decryption, and vote aggregation.

categories.name: Rich Messages & Native Flow
categories.description: Native Flow copy buttons (cta_copy), URL buttons, quick reply, GenAI copy-to-clipboard, rich grids.

categories.name: Events & Stream Listeners
categories.description: Socket EventEmitter: messages.upsert, messages.update, connection.update, creds.update, presence.

categories.name: Group Administration
categories.description: Group metadata, creation, participants update (add/remove/promote/demote), invites, and settings.

categories.name: Channels & Newsletters
categories.description: Newsletter metadata, following, unfollowing, muting, publishing, and invite links.

categories.name: Profile & Privacy
categories.description: Profile status, profile photo, presence (composing/available), blocklist, and privacy queries.
